About Us

We're a small, distributed team that believes great tools should be simple, open, and fast to deploy.

Our Story

This starter began as an internal template we used every time a new client needed a fresh website. After rebuilding the same header, footer, and design-token system for the fifth time, we packaged everything into Astro Fleet — a monorepo starter that ships with shared components, typed design tokens, and a Turborepo build pipeline ready to go.

What We Believe

Good infrastructure should be invisible. Your team should spend time crafting content and conversion flows, not wiring up CSS variables or debugging shared dependency versions. Astro Fleet handles the plumbing so you can focus on what matters.

Open Source First

Everything in this repository is MIT-licensed. Fork it, extend it, and make it your own. If you build something useful on top of it, we'd love to hear about it.
